places.name: Spice Alley
places.description: Lanterns overhead, little kitchens all around. A casual laneway for choosing dinner together, one stall at a time.

photo.alt: Red lanterns above the narrow dining laneway at Spice Alley, Chippendale.
photo.title: Going home gnangarra-51.jpg
photo.author: Gnangarra

places.name: Opera Bar
places.description: A drink beside the harbour, with the Opera House on one side and the bridge on the other. Plan ahead for busy evenings.
places.address: Lower Concourse, Sydney Opera House, Sydney NSW 2000

photo.alt: Tables and visitors at Opera Bar beside Sydney Harbour.
photo.author: Alex Proimos from Sydney, Australia
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Royal Botanic Garden
places.description: Take the long way through palms, garden paths and harbour lawns. Leave room in the afternoon for an unhurried picnic.

photo.alt: Succulents and mature trees in the Royal Botanic Garden, Sydney.
photo.title: Sydney (AU), Royal Botanic Gardens -- 2019 -- 3079.jpg
photo.author: Dietmar Rabich
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: White Rabbit Gallery & Tea House
places.description: Contemporary Chinese art, then tea and a quiet conversation downstairs. The photograph shows the gallery exterior; check exhibition changeover dates.

photo.alt: The brick exterior of White Rabbit Gallery in Chippendale.
photo.title: White Rabbit gallery December 2025.jpg
photo.author: Nick-D
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Circular Quay promenade
places.description: Ferries coming and going, a little sea air, and the city opening out around the water. A lovely meeting point before the rest of the day.

photo.alt: People walking along Circular Quay promenade beside Sydney Cove.
photo.title: AUS Sydney, Central Business District, Circular Quay 012.jpg
photo.author: -wuppertaler
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Observatory Hill Park
places.description: A grassy hill, old trees and one of the city’s best bridge views. Bring a picnic rug and allow for uphill paths.
places.address: Upper Fort Street, Millers Point NSW 2000

photo.alt: Sydney Harbour Bridge and the harbour seen from Observatory Hill.
photo.title: View from Observatory Hill, Sydney (483413) (9443070588).jpg
photo.author: Robert Linsdell from St. Andrews, Canada
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Darling Square
places.description: A whole neighbourhood of dining possibilities around The Exchange. Browse together, then choose a table that suits the group.

photo.alt: The illuminated Exchange building and dining precinct at Darling Square.
photo.title: Darling Square Sydney.jpg
photo.author: MDRX
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Art Gallery of New South Wales
places.description: Let a favourite painting decide the pace. Explore the collection, the architecture and the paths towards the harbour.

photo.alt: The columned entrance to the Art Gallery of New South Wales.
photo.title: Sydney (AU), Art Gallery of New South Wales -- 2019 -- 3103.jpg
photo.author: Dietmar Rabich
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Barangaroo Reserve
places.description: Sandstone edges, native planting and a waterfront walk made for slowing down. Bring water and sun protection.

photo.alt: Grassy lawns, waterfront paths and trees at Barangaroo Reserve.
photo.title: AUS Sydney, Central Business District, Barangaroo Reserve 022.jpg
photo.author: -wuppertaler
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Chinese Garden of Friendship
places.description: Step away from the city into pavilions, winding paths and koi ponds. A small, thoughtful escape; admission charges apply.

photo.alt: A pavilion, pond and rocks in the Chinese Garden of Friendship.
photo.title: 2022-10-15 Chinese Garden of Friendship, Sydney 3.jpg
photo.author: Maksym Kozlenko
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Queen Victoria Building
places.description: Look up at the clocks and stained glass before exploring the arcades. Make an afternoon of browsing and a tea stop.

photo.alt: The ornate interior and Royal Clock of the Queen Victoria Building in Sydney.
photo.author: Kgbo
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Museum of Contemporary Art Australia
places.description: Harbourside contemporary art with plenty to talk about afterwards. Check current exhibition access and ticket conditions.

photo.alt: The sandstone facade of the Museum of Contemporary Art Australia.
photo.title: The Museum of Contemporary Art, Sydney (former MSB Building).jpg
photo.author: Briandhana Krishnatirta Kusaditya

places.name: Paddy’s Markets Haymarket
places.description: Browse the covered stalls for a small find or something unexpected. Trading days vary, so check before setting out.

photo.alt: The Market City entrance above Paddy's Markets in Haymarket.

photo.author: J Bar

places.name: Hyde Park
places.description: A shady pause beneath the fig trees, right in the middle of town. Pair a slow walk with something from a nearby cafe.

photo.alt: A shaded, tree-lined path through Hyde Park in central Sydney.
photo.title: AUS Sydney, Central Business District, Hyde Park 020.jpg
photo.author: -wuppertaler

places.name: State Library of New South Wales
places.description: Reading rooms, sandstone and changing displays. An easy way to turn an ordinary lunch break into a little discovery.

photo.alt: The sandstone Mitchell and Dixson wings of the State Library of New South Wales.
photo.title: Mitchell and Dixson wings, State Library of New South Wales, 2023.jpg
photo.author: Geoff Barker
photo.modifications: Resized and WebP-compressed; cropped to fit in the interface.

places.name: Pyrmont Bridge
places.description: Walk across the harbour on a historic swing bridge. Come back after dark to see the waterfront in a different light.

photo.alt: The pedestrian Pyrmont Bridge crossing Darling Harbour.

photo.author: Nick-D
